Game Overview

Tap Tower puts players into a arcade experience centered on stack shifting platforms with precision in Tap Tower. Perfectly timed taps will help you construct the tallest skyscraper in this thrilling arcade-action game. Challenge your timing skills and compete nationally for sky-high scores and ultimate victory.
